items.title: Automate job applications with browser control
items.oneliner: CLI automates job search with browser actions, ATS-ready resumes, and human approval before every application submission.

items.title: Run DSPy patterns on the BEAM
items.oneliner: Elixir port of DSPy lets you build typed LM programs with OTP processes, supervision, and optimizer-driven prompt tuning.

items.title: Build an ESP32 guitar amp pedal
items.oneliner: ESP32-S3 guitar pedal firmware runs Neural Amp Modeler, touchscreen controls, USB audio, tuner, and microSD presets.

items.title: Self-host federated chat over plain IRC
items.oneliner: Proof-of-concept chat server federates IRC-style messaging across domains using standard IRC clients, DNS discovery, and HTTPS transport.

items.title: Write a Swift kernel in QEMU
items.oneliner: Hands-on walkthrough shows how to boot a minimal ARM64 kernel in Swift with QEMU and Embedded Swift.

items.title: Self-host a site on Tor
items.oneliner: Step-by-step guide shows how to deploy a static site as a Tor hidden service with automated setup.

items.title: Hack a pharmacy LED cross
items.oneliner: Reverse-engineering writeup plus library lets you drive a 24x24 pharmacy LED cross for games, video, and custom animations.

items.title: Enable iPod remote buttons in Rockbox
items.oneliner: Deep reverse-engineering notes uncover Mikey chip registers needed to make iPod earbud remote buttons work in Rockbox.

items.title: Decouple Go modules from GitHub
items.oneliner: Practical guide shows how custom domains prevent Go import paths from breaking when repos move between hosts.

items.title: Avoid Postgres timezone conversion footguns
items.oneliner: Clear Postgres walkthrough explains why AT TIME ZONE UTC changes types and how to avoid silent timestamp bugs.
